About the Gurlz Ride group ride

A women's intermediate trail ride on Doudy Draw and nearby trails, 10–12 miles with 800–1,000 feet of climbing. Skills and community over speed. No-drop.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
